english: he is utterly alone who has no friend
also: he is absolutely lonely who is friendless

terms.latin: Sōlus omnīnō est quī sine amīcō est.
evidence: Aelred of Rievaulx, De amicitia: Sōlus omnīnō est, quī sine amīcō est.
terms.comment: A medieval sentence: Aelred of Rievaulx writes it in his dialogue on friendship, after Vae sōlī (Eccl. 4.10). We have found no ancient source.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
